description: 40 labelled requirement clauses: 20 valid, 20 with a known flaw (4 per tag). Valid clauses are written in the style of public ICT and facilities tenders; flawed clauses were written by hand. Clauses are checked together as one document, in this order, so Conflicting pairs are far apart. 'tags' are the expected flags; 'also_ok' lists extra tags that are defensible and not counted as false positives.

items.text: The system shall support a minimum of 2,000 concurrent authenticated users without degradation of the response times specified in clause 14.
The system shall be user-friendly and intuitive for all officers.
All data at rest shall be encrypted using AES-256 or stronger.
The contractor shall supply 50 units of Apple MacBook Pro 14-inch laptops with M4 Pro chips.
The system shall achieve a monthly availability of at least 99.9%, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least 5 working days in advance.
Audit logs shall be retained online for a minimum of 24 months.
The contractor shall provide on-site support from 8.30am to 6.00pm, Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.
The system shall be highly reliable and shall not fail.
The system shall allow authorised users to export search results in CSV and PDF formats.
The contractor shall migrate all legacy records, train all end users, and provide 12 months of warranty support.
The contractor shall respond to Severity 1 incidents within 30 minutes of notification, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
The solution shall use adequate security measures as appropriate.
The web portal shall conform to WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
The system shall return search results within 3 seconds for 95% of queries under a load of 2,000 concurrent users.
The database shall be Oracle Database 23ai Enterprise Edition.
The contractor shall deliver the system design document within 6 weeks of contract award.
The mobile application shall run on iOS 17 and above and Android 13 and above.
The system shall provide fast response times to users.
The system shall lock a user account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
The system shall encrypt all data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and shall generate a monthly usage report.
Backups shall be performed daily and retained for a minimum of 30 days.
The contractor shall provide a state-of-the-art dashboard with industry-standard features.
The system shall send an email notification to the case officer within 5 minutes of a case status change.
The server room air-conditioning shall maintain a temperature of 22°C ± 2°C and relative humidity of 50% ± 10%.
The system shall use Microsoft SharePoint Online for all document storage.
The contractor shall ensure the delivered system is free of all defects.
The system shall be scalable to meet future needs.
The contractor shall conduct a penetration test by a CREST-accredited tester before go-live and remediate all high and critical findings.
The system shall be a cloud-hosted solution deployed only in the vendor's own proprietary data centre in Tuas.
The contractor shall provide 3 days of administrator training for up to 10 administrators.
Audit logs shall be automatically purged after 12 months.
The system shall support single sign-on using SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect.
The system shall be easy to maintain, etc.
The contractor shall deliver all source code and build scripts to the Authority at the end of the contract.
The system shall be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with no scheduled downtime.
The system shall generate invoices, process refunds, reconcile payments daily, and archive records after 7 years.
The system shall store all documents in PDF/A format for long-term archival.
The contractor shall perform system maintenance every Sunday from 2am to 6am, during which the system will be unavailable.
The contractor shall host the production environment in a data centre located in Singapore.
The system shall validate, store, index and display uploaded files, and shall notify the uploader by SMS.
